correctness.rationale: Exhaustive barycentric orbit-cell enumeration gives 14313 cells; 6411 elementary free-face collapses leave 1491 cells of dimensions 0..3. A maximal-tree quotient presentation has 329 generators and 677 triangle relations; 329 valid Tietze substitutions trivialize it. Integral boundary-square checks and 744 unit-pivot Schur reductions leave one degree-0 and two degree-3 generators, with zero differential, excluding torsion. Simply connected Hurewicz and homological Whitehead identify the wedge of two 3-spheres. Recomputed from the supplied standalone verifier.

value.rationale: The full geometric dihedral orbit space of a natural 3-connected cubic polyhedral graph is a canonical object. Previously determined rational H3 invariants left open possible 2-/3-primary torsion, fundamental group and attaching obstructions; the new integral homotopy classification rules them out. It is a self-contained natural classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine restatement of the character.
